name: C12-15 alkyl benzoate
description: C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate (CAS 68411-27-8 ) is a synthetic ester used as an emollient, plasticizer, and carrier solvent across personal care and industrial formulations. It is produced by esterifying benzoic acid with C12-15 fatty alcohols. This process yields a lightweight, non-greasy fluid that improves spreadability and texture in finished products. In personal care, it functions as a primary emollient and solvent carrier in sunscreens and color cosmetics. Its low viscosity aids UV filter dispersion and enhances skin feel without occlusion in skin-conditioning lotions. Coatings and adhesive formulators use it as a plasticizer to improve flexibility and film formation. In polymer systems and plastics compounding, it acts as a secondary plasticizer that modifies processing behavior and end-product softness. It also serves as a carrier solvent for active ingredients and pigments. The material is effective in both rinse-off and leave-on cosmetic formulations. C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in drum and IBC quantities for large scale manufacturing. Cosmetic-grade material is the standard commercial offering, with product specifications aligned to major pharmacopeial and industry quality benchmarks such as USP and Ph.Eur. standards. Additional quality benchmarks include BP , EP , and FCC requirements depending on the specific application. Technical-grade variants are also available for industrial plasticizer and coatings applications. The product is also tested against ACS and USP criteria to ensure high purity levels.
